skills.name: Plan
skills.description: Turns a goal into a short research plan.
skills.body: Write a concise numbered research plan. Do not edit files.

skills.name: Web research
skills.description: Searches the web for supporting evidence.
skills.body: Use web_search, then summarize findings. Do not edit files.

skills.name: Inspect repo
skills.description: Reads repository files for local evidence.
skills.body: Use request_files to inspect the repo, then summarize. Do not edit files.

skills.name: Review
skills.body: Synthesize the joined branch outputs into a short verdict.

workflows.name: Plan + parallel research
workflows.description: Plan, fan out web + repo, join, then review.
